nodes.name: Normalizar documentos
nodes.notes: Valida el lote de documentos del repositorio. Exige replace_all=true.

parameters.query:
WITH current AS (
  SELECT id, content_hash FROM knowledge_documents
  WHERE source_type = $1 AND external_id = $2
),
upserted AS (
  INSERT INTO knowledge_documents
    (source_type, external_id, title, collection, content, content_hash, canonical_url, metadata)
  VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4, $5, md5($5::text), $6, $7::jsonb)
  ON CONFLICT (source_type, external_id) DO UPDATE
    SET title = EXCLUDED.title, collection = EXCLUDED.collection, content = EXCLUDED.content,
        content_hash = EXCLUDED.content_hash, canonical_url = EXCLUDED.canonical_url,
        metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata, updated_at = now()
    WHERE knowledge_documents.content_hash IS DISTINCT FROM EXCLUDED.content_hash
  RETURNING id
)
SELECT COALESCE((SELECT id FROM upserted), (SELECT id FROM current)) AS document_id,
  (
    COALESCE((SELECT content_hash FROM current), '') IS DISTINCT FROM md5($5::text)
    OR NOT EXISTS (
      SELECT 1 FROM knowledge_chunks c
      WHERE c.document_id = COALESCE((SELECT id FROM upserted), (SELECT id FROM current))
    )
  ) AS changed,
  $1::text AS source_type, $2::text AS external_id, $3::text AS title, $4::text AS collection,
  $5::text AS content, $6::text AS canonical_url, $7::jsonb AS metadata

nodes.name: Registrar fallos
nodes.notes: Rama de error: normaliza los fallos y sigue.

parameters.query:
INSERT INTO knowledge_index_failures (source_type, external_id, chunk_index, reason)
VALUES ($1, $2, $3, $4)

INSERT INTO knowledge_chunks
  (document_id, chunk_index, content, token_count, embedding_model, embedding, metadata)
VALUES ($1::uuid, $2::int, $3::text, $4::int, $5::text, $6::vector, $7::jsonb)
ON CONFLICT (document_id, chunk_index) DO UPDATE
  SET content = EXCLUDED.content, token_count = EXCLUDED.token_count,
      embedding_model = EXCLUDED.embedding_model, embedding = EXCLUDED.embedding,
      metadata = EXCLUDED.metadata
RETURNING document_id, chunk_index

DELETE FROM knowledge_chunks
WHERE document_id = $1::uuid AND chunk_index >= $2::int
RETURNING document_id, chunk_index

nodes.name: Preparar limpieza repo
nodes.notes: Reúne los identificadores del lote actual para borrar del índice lo que ya no está.

parameters.query:
DELETE FROM knowledge_chunks c
USING knowledge_documents d
WHERE c.document_id = d.id
  AND d.source_type = 'repo'
  AND NOT (d.external_id = ANY(string_to_array($1::text, E'\n')))
RETURNING c.document_id, c.chunk_index

DELETE FROM knowledge_documents d
WHERE d.source_type = 'repo'
  AND NOT (d.external_id = ANY(string_to_array($1::text, E'\n')))
RETURNING d.id, d.external_id

parameters.content:
### Ingesta de un repositorio → pgvector

Recibe los Markdown ya preparados (los envía el MCP con knowledge_index_repository).

Exige `replace_all=true`: si un documento ya no viene en el lote, se borra del índice. Así el índice refleja exactamente el estado actual del repositorio.
